name: FLA_RIGHTS_INT
description: FLA_RIGHTS_INT contains lease terms for rights.

columns.name: INTERFACE_RIGHT_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease right identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: RIGHT_NUMBER
columns.description: Right number as generated by the system. Provide this when performing an amendment.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of right as entered by the user.

columns.name: RIGHT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the lease right defined. Provide this when performing an amendment.

columns.name: KEY_DATE
columns.description: Key date for the right as entered by the user.

columns.name: RIGHT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of right which is defined.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: State date of the right as entered by the user.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the right as entered by the user.

columns.name: GRANT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Grant type defined for the right.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DETAILS
columns.description: Reference details of the rights.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT or UPDATE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
